status: Enabled for local Dev integration 8826 only; owner approval 2026-11-01
modelStatus: Current recommended recorded-speech transcription model, verified against official documentation 2026-11-01. Replaces unactivated gpt-4o-mini-transcribe proposal at owner request.
localMode: 8825 retains labelled simulation. 8826 uses same-origin /api/dictation through a server-held DPAPI secret to the dedicated n8n workflow.

rollback: Set budget.enabled=false to block local calls immediately. Typed inputs and simulation remain usable. Dedicated n8n deactivation is a separate explicit action; no existing workflows modified. Encrypted pre-create and pre-activation snapshots under LOCALAPPDATA/Drafted/dev-system-backups/n8n/. No public deployment.
browserLimits: MediaRecorder, microphone permission, and HTTPS or loopback localhost required.
WebM/Opus preferred, MP4 fallback for compatible Safari. No Ogg-only recorder support.
Actual iPhone/Android hardware, OS interruption and Swedish/English recognition accuracy remain unverified.
127.0.0.1 on a phone refers to that phone. A LAN HTTP URL is not a secure microphone context; a separately approved HTTPS test path is needed for physical-device testing.
Leaving/reloading the document cancels audio and in-flight transcription. Audio is not persisted for resuming.
approvedExternalChanges: Create one dedicated POST /webhook/drafted-transcribe endpoint in existing n8n using the server-held OpenAI credential. Do not change existing CV/chat contracts.
Disable success/error execution payload retention for this workflow and avoid binary persistence/logging; verify hosting-level binary retention before activation.
Validate audio MIME and magic, streamed byte limit and server-inspected duration <=120s. inspectDuration is intentionally mandatory but not wired until the runtime is confirmed.
Apply explicit request/concurrency budget and a transcription kill switch before provider invocation; no automatic retries. Proposed initial budget: 100 clips, 10 per minute, 2 concurrent.
Allow exact local integration origin http://127.0.0.1:8826; preserve existing origins. Add only this route to integration CSP/fetch allowlist and enable dictation configuration after approval.
Future public deployment only: add route to existing Cloudflare gateway and shared server-controlled budget. No public deployment is included now.
implementation: Browser normalizes to mono 16kHz PCM WAV. Gateway and n8n derive duration from strict canonical sample bytes; max normalized bytes 3840044. n8n receives JSON, passes inline binary to OpenAI, without binary-storage helper. Execution success/error/manual/progress retention disabled; zero retained execution records after tests. Provider infrastructure retention is not claimed to be zero.
budget: Persistent local server budget: 100 clips total, 10/minute, 2 concurrent; reservations before provider calls; no automatic retries. All tabs share budget. LOCALAPPDATA/Drafted/dictation/budget.json: set enabled=false for immediate kill switch; never reset used to bypass limits.
